Small update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, Linux).

- Easier to read in daytime without shaders: under a bright sky the lyrics get a dark halo and deeper colours instead of a pale glow. Night looks the same as before.

Install: drop the jar into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API (see the [README](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics#install)).
